title: fix(ui): minor polish from end-to-end testing
body:
Closes #84

- Builder heading now reads "Bans and Saves".
- A single-hero team keeps the normal card width in the downloaded comp image.
- The Changelog merges same-date releases into one entry (merged at render time; published history unchanged).
- Added a release note to `releases/pending.json`.

Note: the builder editor always shows 6 slots, so I could not reproduce the single-hero stretch there; only the image export needed the fix.

Screenshots: not attached yet. I did not run the app in a browser.
